name: Zingela
subhead: FLAGSHIP BUSHVELD SAFARI — REMOTE TRAILS, RIVER VALLEYS, AND LODGE ATMOSPHERE
role: Hero product and primary commercial focus
heroImageAlt: Mountain bikers in bushveld landscape at Zingela
overview: Zingela is our signature mountain bike safari — remote bushveld trails, river valley scenery, and a lodge or camp atmosphere that feels unmistakably wild. Guided multi-day riding puts you at the heart of KwaZulu-Natal's safari country, with wildlife ambience and landscapes that sell the experience before you clip in.
whatToExpect: Expect immersive days on the bike, evenings at camp or lodge, and a pace that balances adventure with recovery. Your guides know the terrain and the rhythm of the bush — this is curated riding, not self-guided wandering.
trails: Remote bushveld singletrack and river valley routes, with varied technical sections suited to intermediate+ riders. Terrain mixes open veld, river crossings, and bush corridors — always with a guided safety brief and support.
accommodation: Lodge or camp-style accommodation with safari atmosphere — comfortable beds, communal meals, and the sense of being deep in the landscape rather than passing through.

itinerary.title: Arrival & welcome ride
itinerary.description: Transfer to base, bike check, safety brief, and a shorter orientation ride to settle in.

itinerary.title: Wild trail days
itinerary.description: Full guided riding through bushveld and river valleys, with lunch stops and photographic moments built in.

itinerary.title: Final loop & departure
itinerary.description: Morning ride and farewell — depart with trail stories and safari memories.

exclusions: Flights and transfers to meeting point (unless stated)
